out_text:
What's done, what's in progress, what's the next step?</think>Here's the state of things:

**Done:** The HQMTP draft-head work has produced a locked recipe — naked KD → CE reinforce — reaching chain 0.507 (85.5% of teacher, slots 1–3 exceeding it) at ~13% of draft compute. The subset-KL loss bug (top-64 gathered KL leaving ~32k logits unconstrained) was fixed, which revived KD after pure-KD argmax collapse. That gotcha is now documented on the knowledge-distillation page: naive failure ≠ method failure
